query:
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') as month,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inventory_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quantitySold IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sales_count
FROM (
  SELECT createdAt, quantity, NULL as quantitySold FROM inventory
  UNION ALL
  SELECT createdAt, NULL as quantity, quantitySold FROM sales_transactions
) combined
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month DESC
LIMIT 10;
